examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.
Even I feel a bit ashamed right now.
It became somehow quiet in the room.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
He didn't want to offend anyone.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

поесть.gloss: to eat, to have a meal

meanings.en: to eat, to have something to eat
to stop, put an end to

examples.trans: Stop it! We will have the flat.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare
to send (something or someone to the speaker)

examples.trans: They sent me a free lawyer.

meanings.note: подать на развод = to file for divorce

examples.trans: They went through a difficult divorce.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

meanings.note: тебе смешно = you find it funny

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.trans: We were starting to worry, you see.
